formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (x1 x2 : ℕ) (x3 x4 : Fin x1) (x5 : ℕ → PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),   PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo (x5 (0 : ℕ)) →     (∀ x7 < x2,         ∃ (x9 : ℕ) (x10 : ℕ),           x9 < (x5 x7).size ∧             (x10 < x1 + x9 ∨ x1 + (x5 x7).size ≤ x10) ∧               x5 (x7 + (1 : ℕ)) = PEqualNP.CircuitMoves.eraseGate x1 (x5 x7) x9 x10 ∧                 ((∀ (x11 : Fin x1 → Bool),                     have x12 : List Bool := (x5 x7).wires (List.ofFn (Function.update (Function.update x11 x3 Bool.false) x4 Bool.false));                     x12.getD (x1 + x9) Bool.false = x12.getD x10 Bool.false) ∨                   (x5 x7).output ≠ x1 + x9 ∧ ∀ x11 ∈ List.drop (x9 + (1 : ℕ)) (x5 x7).gates, x1 + x9 ∉ x11.inputs)) →       ∃ (x8 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo x8 ∧ x8.size + x2 = (x5 (0 : ℕ)).size ∧ ∀ (x9 : Fin x1 → Bool), x8.eval (List.ofFn x9) = (x5 (0 : ℕ)).eval (List.ofFn (Function.update (Function.update x9 x3 Bool.false) x4 Bool.false)))
plain_statement: It is false that: If k gates can be erased in turn from a circuit of AND, OR (two-input) and NOT gates, each either equal to another wire whenever x_u and x_v are false or read by no later gate and not the output, then the function with x_u and x_v fixed false has a circuit of that kind with exactly k gates fewer.
title: It is false that: A step toward: A step toward: Cubic piece, cycles at least 7, edge function plus OR-variables: a vertex whose deletion lowers fan-in-two AND/O
